title: ceratoides pungens
intro: Ceratoides pungens, commonly known as Rock Bramble, is a shrub-like perennial plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and relieve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Rock Bramble include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and protect the skin, reduce swelling, and facilitate the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Rock Bramble include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
